verdict.rationale: Firebase documents several programmatic surfaces that cover many console tasks. The official CLI deploys code and assets, reads and writes database data, imports and exports Auth users, and issues non-interactive CI tokens. The official MCP server can create and manage projects, manage Auth users and work with Firestore and SQL Connect data, and SDKs plus the Admin SDK cover data and auth operations. However, nothing in the pack states or shows full parity with the console UI, and probes found no OpenAPI spec at the firebase.google.com paths tried. Missing for 10: an explicit API/console parity claim, a documented management API covering all console features (e.g., Crashlytics, messaging campaigns, Gemini console insights), a machine-readable API spec, and independent corroboration of parity.
